items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: introduced himself as Carl Clauve and he was a banjo player and he said, "I'm with the big band here," he said. And, he said -- "Gee, we need a trumpet player in that band"

ctx.x: Goodman's Palm Gardens and it was a beautiful place and it had a summer garden outside with a shell in it and if it got too warm inside, we'd go out in the garden and play. And, it was one of those--- well, it's almost like the neighborhood tavern today. You know, it was mostly neighbors around there came to the place. It was packed all the time with people.
